label: IsDedekindDomain.AKLB.surjective_tensorProduct_map
title: IsDedekindDomain.AKLB.surjective_tensorProduct_map
statement: The $A$-bilinear map $B\times K\to L$ sending $(b,k)$ to $bk$ is surjective.
proof:
Given $\lambda\in L$ write it as $n/d$ with $0\not=d\in B$. Choose $0\not=a\in A$
  and $b\in B$ with $db=a$ and then note $\lambda=nb/a=nb\times a^{-1}$.
